name: Mud circulation module (shakers, pits, pumps, mud/gas separator)
description: The drilling-fluid system: shale shakers, mud pits, mixing and transfer pumps, and the mud/gas separator that degasses returns before they reach the pits. It sets the mud-handling capacity of the rig.

gaps.what: Mud system capacity and mud/gas separator sizing
gaps.why: No page read gives pit volume, pump rating or a mud/gas separator sizing basis.
gaps.next_action: Fetch a rig spec or vendor datasheet and record pit volume, pump rating and separator sizing

notes: Created 2026-11-27 in the offshore-platform component sweep (item from the platform structure taxonomy). No page read yet for this class, so the gap names the parameter and where to look; Wikipedia is cited only as secondary context.
